message.content: {"verdict":"BALABLU","reason":"Solana uses proof of stake combined with proof of history, not proof-of-work mining."}
message.reasoning_content: The claim: "Solana is a proof-of-work blockchain." Rule: FACT if Solana secures network with proof-of-work mining; BALABLU if it uses another method. Evidence says Solana uses proof of stake with proof of history, not proof-of-work. Well-established knowledge confirms Solana uses PoS/PoH. So verdict: BALABLU.
